## BruFin 0.6.1 — smoother homelab connections

### Connect over a trusted home network

- Android can now opt in to HTTP connections for a trusted private LAN or VPN server. The option is off by default and explains that HTTP does not encrypt the access token or finance data.
- Pairing errors now identify unreachable servers and show the URL/port to check instead of only displaying “Failed to fetch.”

### See which devices are connected

- Give each phone or browser a recognizable device name.
- View connected devices and whether each has been seen recently or is offline.
- BruFin records the last-seen time from authenticated sync requests and removes devices that have been inactive for six months.

### Server deployment

- Portainer now defaults to the v0.6.1 server image. Existing SQLite data remains in the persistent volume during an image update.
- The app remains usable standalone, without a server.
